info.name: Cozy Health API
info.description: Current Cozy Health API contract. OpenAPI is authoritative for operation metadata; maintained collection scripts/examples are preserved. Obsolete unsupported prototype requests are archived separately. Never bulk-run the mutation inventory against shared or production data.

item.name: Age and guardian authorization
item.description: Use synthetic local accounts only. Guardian decision calls are handled by the website server. These saved requests are not evidence of delivery or activation.

item.name: Update residence and end current guardian authorization
Consume emailed token and issue short-lived guardian session

request.description: Website prepares a random 64-character credential in an HttpOnly cookie before confirmation, then supplies it as session. Omit session for legacy server-issued credentials. Opening an email link alone does not confirm or authorize. The emailed token remains single-use. For synthetic development testing only. Never save real tokens/session credentials in this collection.

item.name: Restore a guardian review or read-only decision receipt

request.description: Uses the restricted session credential only. Returns current documents and expires_at without extending the original 20-minute session. A saved decision returns completed=true, decision and message with no private records or new decision authority. Unknown, replaced, cancelled, expired and adulthood sessions cannot resume. Website relay injects the HttpOnly cookie and ignores body credentials. This operation does not accept a decision.

item.name: List team cases with admin:guardians permission
Assign or resolve a scoped age case
Student eligibility
item.description: Development fixtures only. Use a consumer token for own-account verification and a scoped admin:subscriptions token for domains. No request grants paid access. Domain approval requires prior confirmation that addresses are issued only to students. Do not approve a real domain from this example.

item.name: Customer support and privacy
item.description: Development only. Use customer token for owner routes and separately assigned support/privacy admin token for admin routes. See docs/CUSTOMER_OPERATIONS.md. Password fields are placeholders, never committed secrets.

item.name: Reply and reopen own support conversation
List support requests; assigned support capability required
Read support review record and optimistic token
Save private notes or explicitly resolve/reopen
Read support thread with private notes and notification states
Retry only confirmed failed notification; never duplicate reply
Download own approved cloud ZIP with current password
List requests; assigned privacy capability required
Approve, hold or decline verified request; deletion queues durable work
Current application operations — source reconciled
